title: Willem Nolens (Founder, in24 · ex-CEO SolarNow) — Incorruptible's independent mission council idea shaping in24's governance: foundation board with a golden share
summary: Nolens has spent 25 years as an impact entrepreneur: he founded in24, and was CEO of SolarNow from 2011 to 2019, where headcount went from 3 to 1,200. In the final part of his Pulse series, Staying True to the Mission, he set out the structure in24 uses: a foundation board that holds a golden share in the for-profit entity and can step in when the business pulls away from what it exists to do. He credited the book with giving him that shape, and wrote it against two episodes from his own career — an embezzlement case in Accra, and customer satisfaction sliding at SolarNow as short-term sales targets displaced the health of the long-term credit portfolio.
blockquote: Eric Ries's brilliant book 'Incorruptible' gave me a concrete way to organise that counterweight: an independent mission council, with the mandate and authority to intervene when a company drifts from its mission and values.
